title: Phasmophobia
provenance: Reported by L1am-cd (highball-db#55, 2026-09-15), Apple M3, macOS 27, Highball 0.9.10, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r2, DXVK, rated 4 of 5 (playable, minor issues) after 84 minutes. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported playable on DXVK over an 84-minute session. Voice chat works in a match but not in the lobby, and the game's voice recognition does not pick up speech, which the text interface covers. No measurement here yet.

knownIssues.symptom: Voice chat works in a match but not in the lobby (reported on an M3)
Voice recognition does not pick up speech (reported on an M3)
knownIssues.cause: not investigated, the game's Windows speech recognition has no counterpart in Wine
knownIssues.fix: use the game's text interface for the ghost questions
